01_frame_base_upright_tray.notes: Print base underside flat on bed; 180x160x190. Integrated 12mm upright and front/rear root gussets. Four M4 through holes at X60/120,Z172/184.

02_cantilever_vented_head_upper_sensor.notes: Print upside down with Z200 top face on bed. Upper locating rim Ø26 bore and0.8mm extra axial clearance above nominal coil; four M3 columns; no lower ring or large unsupported bridge. Use measured nonmagnetic compliant shims to remove coil play. Integrated rear mounting flange and gussets. Upper Hall allowance12x8x2 recessed atZ198; secure with nonmagnetic adhesive/tape. No extra upper carrier print.

03_helper_cassette_lower_sensor_guard.notes: Print front face Y39 down, 52x8 footprint,52 high,8mm outer brim. Both guard and cassette strips plus end wall touch bed; end-wall closure bridges only3mm. Four M3 socket heads ≤6mm diameter under cassette; NO lower washers. Sensor inserted laterally through3mm open gap; 12x8x2 allowance leaves1mm clearance.
